role: Tests for Deadline.race and runWithTimeout: the caller gets the value, the operation's own error (not the timeout), nil from runWithTimeout on error or deadline, and resumes within 5 s of its own cancellation under a 60 s deadline even though the call never answers.
types: DeadlineTests: class — XCTestCase; nested Planted (the operation's error) and TimedOut (the timeout error)
toplevel: neverAnswers: a file-level @Sendable function that suspends forever and ignores cancellation (a stale link or stalled search).

units.does: Suspends on an unsafe continuation that is never resumed, ignoring cancellation: stands in for a call that never answers.
Asserts Deadline.race(seconds: 5) returns the operation's value (42).
